articles.title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
articles.description:
arXiv:2610.12813v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. articles.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
articles.description:
arXiv:2610.12789v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. articles.title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
articles.description:
